newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Dunaholding swings to loss in Q1-3 '96.
newsitem.headline: Dunaholding swings to loss in Q1-3 '96.

text.p: (Figures in millions of forints unless stated)
Group operating result 820.2 loss vs 9.0 profit
Group financial result 265.3 loss vs 225.6 profit
Group extraord. result 17.2 loss vs 7.4 loss
Group pre-tax result 1,102.7 loss vs 227.2 profit
Group after-tax result 1,103.5 loss vs 209.2 profit
Group net result 1,101.7 loss vs 188.6 profit

NOTE - The figures, consolidated and the 1996 ones unaudited, were calculated according to Hungarian accounting standards. Dunaholding said the field of companies consolidated had changed substantially since the third quarter of 1995.

Dunaholding Rt is a holding company with various business activities. Foreign owners hold 27.6 percent of its shares. The largest single Hungarian shareholder is Korall Kft, with a stake of 24.4 percent, followed by Fundamentum Rt, with 17.3 percent, and Tarkus Kft, with 16.3 percent.
